label: Native Demo Match Packer
description: Packages finished match demos into a .qlmatch. Recording and cutting are the engine's own now: set sv_demoRecord 1 (records every client, upstream semantics) and sv_demoCut 1 (the engine detects match start/end itself, cuts each POV to the match window and names the files after the match). This plugin only listens for demo_match_finalized and launches the external qlmatch-packer (deployed to /home/ql/qlmatch-packer/ by host setup / Update Plugins), which parses the POVs, builds the zip, renders the filename template and delivers via rclone. Requires a minqlxtended build from the fork's demo-match-capture branch at or past the demo-cut redesign (qlds_engine_flavor=minqlxtended, source=build).

cvars.label: .qlmatch name template
cvars.description: Filename template for the finished .qlmatch (no extension). Placeholders: {match_id} {date} {time} {map} {gametype} {players} {pov_players} {total_players} {red_count} {blue_count} {red_players} {blue_players} {teams}. Empty = {match_id}_{map}. Values are sanitized for filenames; if the rendered name has no match stamp and already exists, _{match_id} is appended instead of overwriting.

cvars.label: .qlmatch rclone targets
cvars.description: Comma-separated rclone destinations the finished .qlmatch is copied to (e.g. gdrive:ql-demos/frontier,/home/ql/qlmatch-archive). Each entry is passed to `rclone copy` on the game host — rclone must be installed and its remotes configured there (rclone config). Empty = keep the file local only.

cvars.label: Packer script path
cvars.description: Path to the external qlmatch-packer entrypoint on the game host. When missing (or node is not installed), no .qlmatch is built for that match - only the cut .dm_91 files remain.
